thread:
Lina: Quick heads-up: final RN for 2026-05-04 is ready for review. Small stability patch + a routing tweak. Planning internal announce + stake pin during EU-friendly midday window. Need freeze time + canary schedule.
Raj: Link to draft: https://docs.redwood/internals/rn-2026-05-04-draft. Main bullets: improved kernel fallback, batching timeouts trimmed, deterministic KV eviction fix.
Omar: Ops asks to list exact pinned artifacts and a one-line rollback plan in the RN header. Also want explicit SLO triggers for rollback.
Lina: Proposed pins: runtime v2.16.3, dispatcher v1.10.0, model-redwood-l2@v2026-05-04. Add fallback to model-redwood-l1.
SRE-bot: SRE-bot: alerted on pinned artifacts: runtime v2.16.3 has known notice about driver 520.x; confirm infra nodes are on compatible drivers.
Raj: Infra confirmed drivers ok. Add a short infra note in RN: "Nodes updated to driver 520.x on 2026-05-02".
Omar: Rollback triggers suggested: HTTP 5xx >3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >2.5x baseline for 10m. Approved.
Lina: Freeze timeline: copy freeze 2026-05-04 11:00 UTC. Final signoff 10:45 UTC. Internal announce scheduled T-5m in #announce-internal. War room opens 10:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary plan created -> start=2026-05-04T11:05:00Z end=2026-05-04T11:25:00Z group=6% auto-promote=false
Raj: I'll add a short runbook snippet for quick post-canary checks.
Lina: Please keep RN blurb short for non-eng: one line summary + link to full runbook. Example: "Stability fixes to runtime and routing; no API changes; pinned artifacts and rollback play included."
Omar: Runbook quick-check snippet (ops):
```bash
# quick canary health
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/generate | jq '{latency_ms: .latency_ms, ok: .ok}'
# check pod restarts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[*].restartCount
```
Omar: Rollback condensed steps:
1) Roll dispatcher back to v1.9.8: `kapply dispatcher-v1.9.8.yaml`
2) Scale canary to 0: `rb canary scale model-redwood-l2 0`
3) Promote fallback and restart runtime: `rb promote model-redwood-l1 && kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime`
Lina: Nice. Can we pin RN owners in header? Lina (PM), Raj (Eng), Omar (Ops), Priya (Docs).
Raj: Adding a short note about dashboards: canary dashboard link -> /dashboards/canary-2026-05-04. Will add to RN.
SRE-bot: SRE-bot: reminder: please run preflight probe script on staging by 2026-05-03 18:00 UTC.
Lina: Will do. Final freeze reminder: last edits by 10:45 UTC on 2026-05-04. If no objections, I'll post internal announce at T-5m and stake pin. :rocket:
Omar: SGTM. I'll be in the war room at 10:50 UTC.
Raj: I'll monitor logs 11:05-11:30 UTC.
Lina: Thanks everyone. Closing thread — publish on freeze unless blocker shows. :thumbsup:
